acceptanceGates.name: shot coverage
acceptanceGates.assert: 12 storyboard items enter ProductionRun exactly once

acceptanceGates.name: candidate fanout
acceptanceGates.assert: every shot reaches VideoTask.count=3 and success_count=3

acceptanceGates.name: take ingestion
acceptanceGates.assert: every shot has exactly 3 idempotent ProductionTakes and VideoItems

acceptanceGates.name: technical QC
acceptanceGates.assert: all selected candidates have technical PASS with structured ffprobe metrics

acceptanceGates.name: selection
acceptanceGates.assert: each shot has one QC-approved selectedTakeId owned by Production

acceptanceGates.name: compose
acceptanceGates.assert: selected takes compose through existing VideoComposeService and return HTTP 200 MP4

acceptanceGates.name: idempotency
acceptanceGates.assert: replaying start/reconcile/select/compose creates no duplicate run, take, or output lineage

acceptanceGates.name: runtime recovery
acceptanceGates.assert: one ComfyUI failure and one Redis restart recover without losing step lineage

acceptanceGates.name: legacy compatibility
acceptanceGates.assert: legacy-only and mixed legacy/Production inputs both compose successfully

acceptanceGates.name: evidence
acceptanceGates.assert: Run Capsule records run IDs, workflow/profile versions, hashes, QC, outputs, and failure/recovery refs

fixtureInputs.sourceSelection: existing afv_storyboard_item rows ordered by storyboard_id, episode, scene, sort_order, id
